title: Replace CDN links with GitHub Pages and modernize dictionary theme
description:
## Summary

The legacy `rsacdn.link` CDN is being retired. This repo now publishes via **GitHub Pages** (enabled on `main`, root). This PR repoints the data dictionary references to the Pages URL and modernizes the dictionary.

## Changes

- **Repoint data dictionary links (7 milestone files):** the `credit-risk` dictionary now links to `https://rstudio.github.io/academy-tidyverse-credit-risk/assets/credit-risk_dictionary.html` instead of `rsacdn.link`.
- **Add the dictionary source:** this repo previously shipped only the rendered `credit-risk_dictionary.html` with no source. Added `assets/credit-risk_dictionary.qmd` as native Quarto `format: html` (default **cosmo** theme, `embed-resources: true`), replacing the old R Markdown + `cerulean` + `teachthis` CDN CSS source that lived outside this repo.
- **Re-rendered** `credit-risk_dictionary.html`. The re-render also removes the former external **MathJax** dependency (`mathjax.rstudio.com`), so the file is now fully self-contained.

## Verification

- `grep` confirms **no** `rsacdn`, `cerulean`, or `teachthis` references remain in any `.qmd` or `.html`; the rendered HTML no longer references `mathjax.rstudio.com`.
- Dictionary re-rendered self-contained (no `_files/` sidecar).
- GitHub Pages enabled and building; live dictionary URL returns HTTP 200.

Note: the unrelated `credit-risk_report.qmd`/`.html` pair is not CDN-linked and is left unchanged.
